notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
sqlplus is Oracle's native SQL client. After ODAT discovers valid credentials (scott/tiger or others), sqlplus provides an interactive SQL session. sysdba connection (sqlplus user/pass@SID as sysdba) escalates to SYS user with full DBA privileges.

=== KEY QUERIES ===
SELECT * FROM sys.user$ → all user password hashes
SELECT * FROM user_tables → current user's accessible tables
SELECT table_name FROM all_tables WHERE owner = 'HR' → enumerate specific schema
EXEC utl_file.fwrite(...) → file write if UTL_FILE access granted

=== SYSDBA PATH ===
Any account with SYSDBA privilege: sqlplus user/pass@SID as sysdba → SYS user → full control → sys.user$ hash extraction for offline cracking.
